examples.text: Только давай без вашей мужской солидарности.
examples.trans: Just spare me your male solidarity.

examples.text: Только там тебя ждёт огромный штраф.
examples.trans: Only a huge fine is waiting for you out there.

meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'there'.

examples.text: Там она целует меня на диване.
examples.trans: In there she kisses me on the couch.

examples.text: Они были там вдвоём у окна.
examples.trans: The two of them were there by the window.

examples.text: Только там тебя ждёт огромный штраф.
examples.trans: Only a huge fine is waiting for you out there.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronoun ('you') that declines for case depending on its grammatical function in the sentence.

examples.text: Тебя не учили во время съёмок?
examples.trans: Did they not teach you how to behave during filming?

examples.text: А голову ты дома не забыл?
examples.trans: And did you not forget your head at home?

examples.text: Здорово, ну ты нас вчера напугал!
examples.trans: Hey there, you really scared us yesterday!

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'huge', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Спасибо тебе огромное за помощь, Вика!
examples.trans: Thank you so very much for your help, Vika!

examples.text: Только там тебя ждёт огромный штраф.
examples.trans: Only a huge fine is waiting for you out there.

examples.text: Шансы у нас огромные.
examples.trans: Our chances are huge.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'fine', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Только там тебя ждёт огромный штраф.
examples.trans: Only a huge fine is waiting for you out there.

examples.text: Ресторан заплатит большой штраф.
examples.trans: The restaurant will pay a large fine.

examples.text: Простым штрафом вы здесь не отделаетесь!
examples.trans: You won't get off with a simple fine here!

meanings.note: Conversational Russian particle ('but') that adds modal nuance, emphasis, or negation in spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ладно, Дима, я же уже извинился.
examples.trans: All right, Dima, I already apologized, after all.

examples.text: Катя, мне же всё это приснилось!
examples.trans: Katya, I only dreamed all of that!

examples.text: Я же сказала, решай проблемы сам.
examples.trans: I already told you, solve your problems yourself.

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'in front of' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

examples.text: Ты же перед съёмками подписал договор!
examples.trans: You signed a contract before filming, after all!

examples.text: Я стою перед вами.
examples.trans: I'm standing in front of you.

examples.text: Перед домом машина.
examples.trans: There's a car in front of the house.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'filming', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Ты же перед съёмками подписал договор!
examples.trans: You signed a contract before filming, after all!

examples.text: Вы зачем продали Герману эту запись?
examples.trans: Why did you sell German that recording?

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (root 'писать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to sign', forming an aspectual pair with 'подписывать'.

examples.text: Ты же перед съёмками подписал договор!
examples.trans: You signed a contract before filming, after all!

examples.text: Пока всё не подпишешь, не выйдешь.
examples.trans: You won't leave until you sign everything.

examples.text: Подпишите здесь.
examples.trans: Sign here, please.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'contract', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Ты же перед съёмками подписал договор!
examples.trans: You signed a contract before filming, after all!

examples.text: По договору я должен только сниматься.
examples.trans: According to the contract I only have to appear on camera.

examples.text: По какому ещё договору, ты слышишь?
examples.trans: According to what contract, do you hear me?
